'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Note: If you had previously stored a full set of Sunfire armour in the stash unit prior to the april 2024 update, and go to rebuild the deleted stash unit, you will get back your initially stored full set of Sunfire armour.
